functions_and_methods.rule: Must always start with a verb indicating an action

constants_global.rule: Only for global or static module-level constants

files_and_directories.rule: Ensures cross-OS compatibility across Windows, Linux, and macOS

solid_principles.single_responsibility: A class or module should have only one reason to change.
solid_principles.open_closed: Extend functionality via inheritance, adapters, or middleware; do not modify working core code.
solid_principles.liskov_substitution: Derived classes must be fully substitutable for their base classes without breaking logic.
solid_principles.interface_segregation: Segregate interfaces; do not force systems to depend on methods they do not use.
solid_principles.dependency_inversion: Depend on abstractions (interfaces), not concrete implementations.

guidelines.single_source_of_truth: Logic and configuration must exist in only one place. Refactor immediately on 3rd duplicate.
guidelines.readability_over_cleverness: Write code so that maintainers can easily reason about it. Avoid over-engineering.
guidelines.parameter_encapsulation: If more than 3 parameters are needed, encapsulate them in an Object/Interface DTO.
guidelines.prefer_pure_functions: Functions should ideally have no side effects, with output strictly dependent on input.

security_and_data.input_validation: Sanitize and validate all data at the system boundary (CLI args, stdin, DTOs, configs).
security_and_data.secrets_management: Never commit .env files; no ambient production credentials; no hardcoded tokens.
security_and_data.least_privilege: Default scopes and access permissions must be strictly restricted; read-only default.
security_and_data.path_traversal_protection: Always normalize and verify target paths stay within allowed directories.
security_and_data.command_injection_protection: Do not concatenate unsanitized user inputs into child processes or shell commands.

performance_and_resources.big_o_optimization: Prefer Hash Maps / Sets O(1) over array iteration O(n) for lookups.
performance_and_resources.resource_release: Explicitly close connections, streams, and file handles in finally blocks.
performance_and_resources.concurrency: Use Promise.all() for independent asynchronous operations instead of sequential await.
performance_and_resources.runtime_footprint: Zero-runtime-dependencies for hooks; fast cold start latency < 20ms.

testing_and_typing.strict_typing: Strict TypeScript or Python type hints; avoid the any type completely; use unknown with type guards.
testing_and_typing.immutability: Prefer const over let; use spread operators or structuredClone for state updates.

ci_cd_policy.mandatory_precommit_check: All offline suites and integrity checks must pass before commit or pushing to remote.
